scores.claim_text: Operates a joint venture with GE Aerospace.
scores.supports: Mode B: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Woodward', cik='0000040545' [GE / GE Aerospace], cutoff_date='2026-05-20') -> 0 total hits. The JV (historically: EGT — Engine Alliance / similar JV referenced repeatedly in Woodward's 10-K) is not surfaced by full-text search of GE's filings under the 'Woodward' search term at this CIK. Counterparty-disclosure threshold heuristic 7: GE Aerospace is large; the JV is repeatedly highlighted in Woodward's forward-looking statements ('plans and expectations relating to the performance of our joint venture with GE Aerospace'), and is a material item for Woodward. Zero counterparty hits on a JV name search is mildly suspect, but EDGAR FTS at this CIK may not cover GE Aerospace's post-spin filings (GE Aerospace's CIK lineage may be split between legacy GE and a newer registrant). Calibrated to MOD rather than SEVE given likely CIK-naming-coverage issue.
scores.interpretation: Counterparty disclosure search returned zero; calibrated to MOD due to GE Aerospace CIK-lineage ambiguity (legacy GE CIK 0000040545 may not capture post-2024 spinout filings).
